set.body:
Journey: Open. Track: tools.

Outcome
A researcher opens the Neurobagel query tool, asks for a cohort, sees the Sanctity study with the matching subject count and follows the link back.

Acceptance
1. A digest-pinned Neurobagel node (graph store, node API and query tool) starts from a compose file under tools/publish/neurobagel-node, bound to loopback or the institute network only.
2. sanctity-publish neurobagel with a load option uploads the saved JSON-LD (OPEN3). A query that should match returns the study with the expected count. A query that should not match returns nothing.
3. Following the access link lands on the study page, with sign-in required, or on the DOI page.
4. An unload option removes the dataset, and a fresh query no longer returns it. Replacing a record after a new release is unload followed by load.
5. A short page says what joining the public federation would take, including the aggregate-only option that one public node already uses, as input to OPEN0.

Not in scope
Generation fencing, approval binding and restart probes (NB02, parked). A public listing.

Evidence
Scripted query checks. The OPEN5 rehearsal.
set.title: OPEN4: Find the study by cohort query in a private Neurobagel node (was NB03)
